causal_timeline.event: R1 release-repair proof run 35323715835 started on candidate head 48ee77767f17056de735cdc4031dcc6091e9b685.
The isolated hosted-staging candidate became healthy, unauthenticated bootstrap returned 401, and employee login completed successfully.

The proof stored the session in a curl cookie jar while calling the application over plain loopback HTTP with X-Forwarded-Proto=https, then replayed the jar with curl -b. The authenticated bootstrap returned 401, so API continuity was marked failed.

The same candidate lineage and runtime passed after the synthetic harness captured the successful login Set-Cookie header, proved the cookie is Secure, and replayed only its session token with an explicit Cookie header on the isolated loopback request. Both authenticated bootstrap and /api/personal passed.

inferred_root_cause.statement: The failing oracle mixed hosted HTTPS semantics with a plain loopback transport and delegated session replay to a cookie jar. The canonical repository harness instead treats loopback as an isolated transport shim: it verifies the successful Set-Cookie contract and explicitly supplies the resulting session token. The latter passed against the exact candidate, so the red CI signal was a harness transport defect rather than evidence of broken product authentication.

prevention.rule: A hosted-staging synthetic proof must not use a plain-HTTP loopback curl cookie jar as the sole authenticated-session oracle. Use real TLS, or explicitly capture and validate Set-Cookie and then send the session token only within an isolated loopback harness.

metrics.reproducibility: original pattern failed deterministically; corrected transport pattern passed on the same R1 lineage
metrics.recovery_path_quality: high: no application change or restart required; replace the invalid synthetic transport oracle
metrics.prevention_coverage_change: manual CI interpretation -> machine-readable detection of plain-loopback secure-session cookie-jar misuse

safety_boundary: Test harness and prevention only. No production, Railway, credential, tenant, payroll, workforce or consequential security-state mutation is authorized by this record.
